Headline: Forest Park-bound Blue Line Delays
ShortDescription: Blue Line trains are running with residual delays and congestion following an earlier door problem at Western O'Hare. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are running with residual delays and congestion following an earlier door problem at Western O'Hare.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
